fix(themes): every bundled theme draws named colours in its own ANSI table (rich-docs-examples-xuu.8tt) (#179)

* fix(themes): every bundled theme draws named colours in its own ANSI table (rich-docs-examples-xuu.8tt)

defineTheme gave every TerminalTheme STANDARD_TABLE, so `[blue]` exported
under ATOM_ONE_DARK was VGA #000080 on #282c34. Each theme data file now
carries a required `ansi` table, taken from the published terminal scheme
whose background matches the theme (iTerm2-Color-Schemes), from Rich for
`default` and `svg-export`, and from Textual's own MONOKAI/ALABASTER
fallback for the Textual-native themes and cyberpunk, which have none.

Atom One uses "One Half Dark/Light": the "Atom One Light" port draws cyan
as the same #3F953A as green.

* fix(themes): textual-ansi keeps VGA, derived once from STANDARD_TABLE; ANSI slots are opaque; EIGHT_BIT 0–15 draws through the theme (rich-docs-examples-xuu.8tt)
